Theorem
[classification of two-dimensional steady solitons] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 4.4.3\group Cao–Zhu Ricci Solitons The only complete steady Ricci soliton on a two-dimensional manifold with bounded curvature which assumes its maximum $1$ at an origin is the ``cigar" soliton on the plane $\mathbb {R}^2$ with the metric \[ ds^2=\frac{dx^2+dy^2}{1+x^2+y^2}. \]
